title: Engine operations
description: The functions through which the page and the Worker drive a game.

entities.name: Start a game
entities.description: A fresh game from a mode, a number of players and a seed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and replay() call it.
entities.result: A new Game: one ship per player at its spawn point (the middle for one, a ring for more), each with 3 lives and guarded for 3 s; no ships in attract mode. The first wave comes after WAVE.opening.
failures: players outside 1 to 9 is clamped, not refused.

entities.name: Step a game
entities.description: Advances a game by one fixed step of 1/60 s with every player's controls.
entities.result: The game is moved on in place: ships, shots, rocks, pods and drones move and collide, waves start and clear, scores and lives change, and Game.over turns true once every player is out. Game.events lists what happened in this step.
failures: A missing input plays as IDLE.

entities.name: Rank the players
entities.description: The ships of a game, best score first.
entities.result: A new array of the ships, best score first; ties keep player order.

entities.name: Record a step's controls
entities.description: Adds one step's controls to a game's recording, logging only changes.
entities.transport: method Recorder.record(inputs), called right before each step()
entities.result: For each player whose controls changed, a triple [steps since the previous change, player, controls as bits] is appended to the log; the step count goes up by one.

entities.name: Check a recording's shape
entities.description: Whether a value is a well-formed recording, before it is played.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The Worker's score() calls it on a submission.
entities.result: true for a mode of coop or versus, 1 to 9 players, a 32-bit seed, 1 to MAX_STEPS steps, and a log of whole triples with valid players and 5-bit controls, at most MAX_LOG numbers long.

entities.name: Replay a recording
entities.description: Plays a recorded game again through the engine.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The Worker (worker/scores.ts) calls it on every submission.
entities.result: The finished Game, with every player's score and the wave reached.
failures: A recording that fails validRecording: null.
The game ends before the recording's last step: null.
The game hasn't ended by the last step, or some changes in the log were never used: null.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases whose steps call them.
